title: nuttallia chrysantha
intro: Nuttallia chrysantha, commonly known as the Chrysanthemum root, is a type of flowering plant native to Asia, specifically the root part is used in traditional medicine. The health benefits of Nuttallia chrysantha include its ability to lower fever, relieve coughs, and reduce inflammation. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its sedative and antipyretic effects, which help to calm the mind and body, and its ability to induce sweating, which helps to relieve fever. The bioactive constituents of Nuttallia chrysantha include flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
